operations.method: Exhaustive attachment top-5%, exhaustive tactical top-5% per survivor, then SCIP calibration
operations.score_model: Strict ADS recoil then Handling. Automatic pattern: V + multiplier * H over 20 ADS source-chart points; H=max(abs(x)) from pre-fire origin. Candidate fastest 200ms net horizontal speed selects multiplier: 1 up to 3, 4 above 3, 6 above 4, 10 above 5 model units/s. Exact piecewise-linear maximum; no P90. Pattern/camera/kick weights 40/30/30; default-normalized. Unsupported base firing protocols retain the legacy multiplier proxy. Experimental, not client-validated.
limitations: Legacy recoil multiplier proxy retained: Requested shots exceed this build magazine; no reload or silent truncation is modeled. No horizontal-speed tiers applied.

result.method: Exhaustive attachment top-5%, exhaustive tactical top-5% per survivor, then SCIP calibration
result.score_model: Weighted handling / hip-fire accuracy / ADS recoil loss: 50/30/20. Accuracy minimizes idle hip-fire spread; maximum spread is excluded. Handling averages default-normalized ADS and sprint-to-fire times. Ordinary ADS ranks airborne ADS under the shared-scaling assumption. Recoil is the shared provisional ADS-only pattern/camera/kick proxy.
limitations: Accuracy uses idle hip spread; moving spread is proportional and jumping mechanics remain unknown. Maximum spread is excluded.
Ordinary ADS ranks airborne ADS assuming a build-independent airborne multiplier (user hypothesis; not client-verified).
Range-aware hit probability is not modeled; angular spread is minimized.
Handling uses equal normalized ADS/sprint-to-fire weights; recoil is an unvalidated proxy.
